name: Großer Zeltplatz
beschreibung: The campsite 'Großer Zeltplatz' is located in the Inntal in Tirol, near a small village. It lies at the edge of the forest and is surrounded by steep, wooded mountain slopes. The surrounding area offers marked hiking trails in summer and access to nearby ski areas in winter. The facilities include sanitary facilities, a common room, and electricity connections for vehicles and tents. Guests can expect a close-to-nature camping experience with basic infrastructure. Day trips into the surrounding valleys and to the mountain peaks are possible from here.
